sample_unit: publicly accessible patient-facing RAG chatbot deployments

links.outcome: Unauthenticated access to chatbot backend configuration and patient conversation records
links.effect: Ordinary browser inspection exposed the system prompt, RAG configuration, API schema, knowledge base, and the 1,000 most recent patient-chatbot conversations, all retrievable without authentication.
links.quote: The deployment also contradicted its privacy assurances: full conversation records, including health-related queries, were retrievable without authentication.

links.outcome: Privacy and security failures in a deployed patient-facing chatbot that went unidentified before deployment
links.effect: Serious privacy and security failures were identified with standard browser tools, without specialist skills or authentication; the authors conclude independent review should be a prerequisite for deployment.
links.quote: Serious privacy and security failures in patient-facing RAG chatbots can be identified with standard browser tools, without specialist skills or authentication; independent review should be a prerequisite for deployment.

screen.reason: The study conducts an empirical security and privacy vulnerability assessment of a real deployed patient-facing medical RAG chatbot, evaluating backend/client data exposure and privacy controls.

primary.practice: security and privacy auditing / independent pre-deployment review
